messages.subject: envelope vs oscillogram - defining colors
parts:
Dear list members,

I have a question about one of the functions of the seewave.
When I use the "oscillo" function, I would like to have a plot with
the actual oscillogram in black and the actual envelope in red or
another color. Based on the manual that I have, the colors should be
defined using the "colwave" argument. But actually when I use it, let
say, choosing the color "red", not only the envelope is red but all
the oscillogram. Now, how can I define different colors for the
oscillogram an for the envelope? I'm running seewave under ubuntu
10.01 and working with sperm whale clicks.
Many thanks for your kind help,

Nino

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] envelope vs oscillogram - defining colors
parts:
Dear Nino

The function oscillo() only plots the oscillogram, not the envelope.
The envelope can be obtained through the function env().

Here is a way to get what you need

data(tico)
oscillo(tico, f=22050)
par(new=TRUE)
env(tico, f=22050, colwave=2)

This is actually taken from an example provided on seewave webpage:
http://rug.mnhn.fr/seewave/
tab EXAMPLES

Hope this helps

Best

Jerome
